description: Lists published upcoming events at beach clubs in the United Arab Emirates (brunches, ladies' days, parties, live music) with Dubai local times, ticket prices and the BeachClubs.ae event page link. Paginated.

beach_club_id.description: Beach club id (UUID) to limit events to one club.

emirate.description: Emirate filter. Accepts names, abbreviations (DXB, AD, RAK, ...) and Arabic names.

from.description: Start of the date range: YYYY-MM-DD (Dubai date) or an ISO timestamp. Defaults to now.

limit.description: Number of events per page, 1 to 50. Default 20.

offset.description: Number of events to skip, for pagination. Default 0.

to.description: End of the date range, inclusive: YYYY-MM-DD (Dubai date) or an ISO timestamp.

name: list_events
title: List beach club events
